steps.content:
05:25, August 15, N.F. 113
Temporary Command of the FAC-HUSH Joint Task Force

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The criminal attacked the temporary command post, used a transport vehicle to kidnap the Commander-in-Chief, license no. DS-3864H. The vehicle just passed the Rust and is now heading towards Eastside.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Judging from the life signs monitoring, the Commander is still alive, there is still time. The enemy getting such accurate information indicates that the Underground has infiltrated FAC.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The core rescue operation will be carried out by the <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos HUSH unit</color>. The operation time is 2 hours and 13 minutes. Rescue the Commander before the designated meeting time. Prevent the spread of panic.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: FAC's main force should not act, do not disclose any information, inform them that the Commander will arrive on time. During this period, anyone who behaves abnormally, spreads panic, or investigates the Commander's whereabouts may be a spy from the Underground, and will be closely tracked by the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Underground has sent an invitation for a skirmish, this is also our chance. The West District operation proposal will definitely be passed, we should clean ourselves up before the war begins, and eliminate all moles.

When Christina wakes up, her surroundings are pitch black. The space is vibrating, as if she's in a vehicle. Christina gropes around, besides the dark metal boxes, there are even many people piled up next to her.
Her phone is gone, Christina can't contact the outside world, so she takes out a small flashlight to shine around.
There are guards and bureaucrats around, as well as some high-ranking individuals whom she can't identify, but they are all unconscious, with small "flowers" blooming on their bodies.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Of course, it's her.
She hastily checks everyone she can see. Fortunately, the degree of blooming is not deep. It seems to be just a means for Coquelic to control people.

Among these people, Christina finds one who is different. He is old but robust, has grey hair and his body is full of injuries. Many parts of his body have been replaced with machinery, and he is under more severe restrictions than the average person, falling into a deep unconsciousness.
This face, Christina remembers seeing it on TV.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...The FAC Commander-in-Chief...?

Christina immediately understands her situation—<color=#fb9259>"as year's end nears, vast and wide, over dried-up wells, I alone stride"</color>. This is the real <color=#fb9259>fourth scene</color> corresponding to the <color=#fb9259>fourth line of the poem</color>. And she, as one of the "victims," was attacked last night and brought here.
(Rustling...)
Perhaps sensing someone's awakening, a red light emerges from the corner of the shadows. Christina looks over to see the red light transform into muck, coalescing into filthy humanoid forms.
These are the puppets from the Underground that Shalom once told her about.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I was right, she really is in cahoots with the Underground scoundrels.
Even Christina is now a victim, which means the criminal no longer needs a detective. This is the <color=#fb9259>final case</color>.
Christina slaps her face hard, turning her cheeks bright red.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Great, there's still time. I won't let you get your way this time!
